QUOTE: "`LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize` (lines 49–71) calls `llama_tokenize` once with a null buffer and size 0. llama.cpp answers with a negative number giving the required token count, and the code negates it (`if (n < 0) n = -n;`). It allocates a vector of that size and calls `llama_tokenize` again to fill it."
